required_operation_ids: command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint review BLUEPRINT --target-authority AUTHORITY --pretty
command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint review BLUEPRINT --target-authority AUTHORITY --material-root ROOT --pretty
command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint bundle-export BLUEPRINT --target-authority AUTHORITY --output BUNDLE --pretty
command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint bundle-export BLUEPRINT --target-authority AUTHORITY --material-root ROOT --output BUNDLE --pretty
command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint bundle-query BUNDLE --module|--element|--case|--impact|--reverse ID --pretty

block_on.condition: a required blueprint projection or its blueprint, review, relation-set, recipe, target-revision, or evidence fingerprint is missing, stale, foreign, ambiguous, or caller-rehashed
the canonical author/full-review route is replaced, bypassed, or duplicated
any route-specific blueprint obligation lacks current target-native evidence or is replaced by AI prose or a self-declared pass
the first gap, outside-scope branch, unsupported claim, closure handoff, or bounded claim required by this route is omitted or promoted to pass
explicit_material_root is treated as the blueprint directory, searched, downloaded, or reviewed without the caller-selected --material-root, or external_resource_not_run is promoted
FMI caller expectations or native outputs replace the restricted source-independent oracle or are conflated with its result
the full bundle is emitted as the default prompt payload, more than one deep selector is accepted, a byte budget is bypassed, or an identity-only terminal is silently repaired
bundle presence, observed-at-export status, a frozen-case pass, or an AI answer is promoted to current native execution, fresh evidence, or high-fidelity reconstruction

blueprint_route_contract.claim_boundary: This is the sole PhysicsGuard author/full-review authority for the declared physical target and inventory. Explicit external material is never inferred, FMI observations remain bound to a restricted independent oracle, and portable bundle status remains frozen interpretation with execution_claim_licensed=false; none proves fresh native execution or unsupported high-fidelity truth.

claim_boundary: This guard-model proof blocks only candidate admission when declared target-native obligation evidence is missing or native-failed. It does not independently detect the underlying physical, mapping, topology, workflow, or evidence defect and does not certify upstream truth.
